response.original_title: SPIRIT: On Tour With A Christmas Carol
response.overview: SPIRIT is a feature documentary that follows a professional touring production of A Christmas Carol as it attempts to build an ambitious national tour in just twelve days. Beginning inside a rehearsal studio, a company of actors, musicians, and technicians race to transform individual performances into a cohesive ensemble before moving into technical rehearsals.
response.tagline: Two vans. One classic. Countless lives changed.
response.title: SPIRIT: On Tour With A Christmas Carol
